title: Normalized inverse-limit adic lisse realization model data
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime, $\Omega$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $X$ a Noetherian separated scheme of finite Krull dimension on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Use the finite coefficient fields and their valuation rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], the classical lisse adic category [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], and the completed common-stage category [def-weil-pbc-qbar-category]. The normalized adic lisse model datum consists of the following functors and specified comparisons. Integral realization is the actual inverse limit of the etale-to-pro-etale reduction tower, placed in degree zero, restricted by the bounded-constructible-complete membership proof and then rationalized. The coefficient comparison is an equivalence of the completed common-stage category with the sf common-stage constructible category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], identified at every integral stage with the restriction of the canonical completed coefficient-presentation transport [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport]. Realization on all classical algebraic-coefficient lisse sheaves agrees with these integral realizations; on a rational map $a\otimes f$ it is scalar multiplication by $a$ followed by the realized integral map. Cohomology in every integer degree is induced by integral cohomology [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]; lisse realization is concentrated in degree zero. At every geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], the fibre is actual completed derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], degree-zero cohomology, point sections and coefficient extension to $\Omega$; its composite with lisse realization is identified with the classical adic fibre functor [def-pod-lisse-adic-fibre-functors]. The coefficient prime's residue-field invertibility is inherited from its stalkwise unit property. This is model data only: no tensor calculation theorem or Frobenius pullback comparison is part of this datum.
